companyIntro.name: Tradewind Supply Partners
companyIntro.mission: Source the right goods at the right total cost, fairly and on time.
companyIntro.culture: Fair process, documented decisions. If you cannot justify an award in writing, you cannot make it.

projectBackground.name: Regional Materials Tender
projectBackground.context: Two suppliers bid. One is cheaper per unit but has higher freight and defect rates.

manager.name: Selin Demir
manager.role: Head of Procurement, Tradewind Supply Partners
manager.note: The cheapest price is not the cheapest supplier. Show me total cost and a fair process I can defend to an auditor.

assignment.title: Evaluate the tender and recommend an award
assignment.brief: Compute total cost, apply fair evaluation rules, handle a conflict of interest and write the recommendation.

documents.name: Supplier A Bid
documents.note: €100 per unit for 1,000 units; freight €4,000; 2% defect rate.

documents.name: Supplier B Bid
documents.note: €95 per unit for 1,000 units; freight €9,000; 5% defect rate.

tasks.title: Total Cost Supplier A
tasks.prompt: Supplier A: 1,000 units at €100, freight €4,000, plus rework of 2% of units valued at €100 each. What is total cost (€)?
tasks.reasoning: Total cost includes freight and quality cost.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Cost Difference
tasks.prompt: Supplier B: 95,000 + 9,000 freight + 5% rework (€5,000) = €109,000. How much cheaper is Supplier A than B (€)?
tasks.reasoning: The 'cheaper' unit price loses once all costs are included.
tasks.tip: Show both totals side by side.
tasks.mistake: Awarding on unit price costs the client €3,000.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Fair Evaluation
tasks.prompt: How should evaluation criteria be handled?
options: Fix and publish weights before opening bids and apply them to all bidders equally
Adjust weights after seeing the bids
tasks.reasoning: Pre-agreed criteria protect fairness and defensibility.
tasks.tip: No criteria changes after bids open.
tasks.mistake: Changing criteria afterwards invites legal challenge.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Conflict of Interest
tasks.prompt: An evaluator discovers a relative owns one bidder. What is correct?
options: Declare it immediately and step away from evaluating that bid
tasks.reasoning: Conflicts must be declared to protect integrity.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Tender Documents
tasks.prompt: Select what a good tender pack includes.
tasks.tip: Answer all clarifications to every bidder.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Award Recommendation
tasks.modelAnswer: I recommend awarding to Supplier A. Its total cost is €106,000 against €109,000 for Supplier B once freight and a 2% versus 5% defect rate are included, and its quality record lowers delivery risk. The evaluation followed the weights agreed before bids opened and no conflicts of interest were declared. Contract terms should include a quality clause with rework at the supplier's cost. B can be retained as a secondary source for resilience.
tasks.reasoning: A good award recommendation compares total cost, cites the process and mitigates risk.
tasks.mistake: An unreasoned award is hard to defend.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Cheapest Bid
caseStudy.background: A buyer awarded a €1.2M contract to the lowest price. Late deliveries and defects added €280,000 in cost and a production stoppage.
questions: Why did the cheapest bid cost more?
How do you manage supplier risk?
caseStudy.solution: Tradewind adopted total-cost evaluation with quality and delivery scoring.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Evaluate total cost and risk, not price alone.
